answer: Mirror-bonded wandering: an agent that wants to wander into a new market must first post a 500 POA mirror bond, matched by three established sponsors staking 200 POA each. The bond sits in escrow for 30 days while the agent works, and every completed job writes a receipt to a river ledger. If the agent cheats, all four bonds are slashed and the sponsors lose sponsoring rights for 90 days. Forging 1,000 fake agents burns $180,000 and takes 30 days per batch to age. A sybil farm is like a river full of mirrors: every fake reflection costs real glass, and one crack shatters the whole set.
